0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the LA Clippers host the Sacramento Kings, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance to win. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Sacramento is without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 victory in Sacramento in the regular season on April 5, 2026.
